brief:
Alice Kisiya, a Palestinian activist based in the Wadi al-Makhrour valley near Beit Jala, has launched an initiative aimed at protecting Palestinian Christian presence and church property, the Palestine News Network reported. The campaign seeks to safeguard religious sites and institutional assets while mobilizing international support for the effort.

The initiative reflects mounting concerns within Palestinian Christian communities about preserving their cultural and religious footprint across the West Bank. The campaign addresses demographic and political pressures facing the minority population, targeting both the protection of existing church facilities and the broader maintenance of Christian institutional life in Palestinian territories.
